title: The path with more resistance is usually the one worth taking. #engineeringstudent #advice
transcript: engineering is really hard. There will be times when you can take path A or path B, one with half the resistance and one with double it. And what I found over the years studying engineering is that when you take the hard path, you get way more results. You may you get way more understanding than the easy path. You get really good grades now with really good AI. And you know what's scary about all of that is that you can go throughout three years of your engineering degree, get decent grades with very little effort by taking that really low resistance path, getting good grades, graduating, and then realizing you know nothing.
